notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1141262_puerta_de_europa.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Both towers in one model, because Wikidata and Wikipedia have one item for the pair (the towers' own items Q56787231 and Q56787345 are parts of it). +Z faces south-south-west, down the Castellana towards the Plaza de Castilla, the classic view of the 'gate'; +X points to the east tower. Each tower is a 35.6 × 36.0 m prism leaning 14.3° towards the other, floors level (built upright and sheared). Bases from the OSM ground-floor parts; with the published 14.3° the roofs overhang about 2.6 m further towards the Castellana than the OSM floor parts (which imply about 13°). Façades simplified: black-blue glass with a fine grid, stainless central band and tier bands on the vertical façades, the stainless X bracing on the leaning ones, red lines in every panel, stainless corner columns and crown frame; heliports with red/blue outlines. Company logos (Realia, Bankia/CaixaBank) left out. The footprint is two rectangles (each tower seen from above, + 1 m) joined by a 10 cm slit, so the Castellana and the Plaza de Castilla between the towers are not cleared.
